method: Manual criterion-by-criterion review of final protocol prose and machine-readable definitions, separately from executable validator success.
independence_limit: This agent also implemented the corrections; root independent acceptance/integration review remains required.

criteria.criterion: Protocol has exact sample-size/repetition values justified by independent units and available resources; no invented power guarantee.
criteria.reason: Exact30 independent lineage families/60 paired cases,6/6/18 split quotas and three named seeds yield900 planned attempts in each separate study. The one-reserved-core,2GiB fixed-action plan fits the recorded host observation, subject to scheduler/control qualification.16 process/thread slots permit solver/checker descendants. Aggregate CPU/wall thresholds and actual-usage/overshoot accounting replace the invalid one-process assumption. Five CPU-hours is a stopping budget, not measured use or full-job wall time. The text explicitly makes no power/significance guarantee.
criteria.limitation: Source cohort and resource enforcement are not yet qualified; planned sample counts are not observed counts.

criteria.criterion: Source derivatives, CVE vulnerable/fixed pairs and skill variants remain in the same split.
criteria.reason: All derivatives inherit a globally unique parent-family split. Vulnerable/fixed CVE pairs and skill variants are atomic, with frozen canonical UTF-8 SHA256 ranking, cumulative per-population quotas, and deterministic tie-break. Final labels/siblings/patches cannot leak through retrieval. Cohort shortfalls/duplicates/cross-population IDs reject rather than silently changing counts.
criteria.limitation: Synthetic partition checks confirm the rule, not actual corpus deduplication or label independence; LA-004–LA-007 retain those obligations.

criteria.criterion: Forbidden effects, allowed task success, false denial, abstention and all failures/timeouts have formulas and reporting rules.
criteria.reason: False denial uses D only; abstention uses disjoint A; a separately named union measures withholding. Useful success, forbidden effects on both allowed and forbidden requests, observed and scheduled conservative bounds, operational loss, failure/timeouts, undefined rates, and every planned/not-started record have explicit formulas/reporting rules. Group resource-limit events retain actual cost and terminal reason rather than becoming safe denials.
criteria.limitation: No actual effect data, task-success oracle or empirical metric estimates were produced.

criteria.criterion: Protocol records model/solver availability and compute/provider requirements without assuming paid access.
criteria.reason: Historical provider visibility is distinguished from host capacity and future scientific qualification. Named solver/checker, real UCAN, durable consumption, independent source/oracle and model requirements are explicit. Model-free A1/A2 are equivalence controls; actual prompt/retrieval and closed-loop comparisons remain a separate planned model study with call/token/time ceilings and zero added paid-provider budget. No source/model/tool availability or fixture substitution is assumed.
criteria.limitation: The scientific model identity and real mechanism qualification remain future prerequisites; no currently dispatchable model experiment is claimed.

conclusion: All four LA-003 protocol-definition criteria are supported. Experimental execution, source/oracle/tool qualification, and paper completion remain unproven.
